events.title: The Battle of the Frigidus opens between Theodosius I and Eugenius
events.description: On the river Frigidus, probably the Vipava in present-day Slovenia, the western usurper Eugenius and his Frankish general Arbogast held their positions against the eastern emperor Theodosius I on the first day of battle. Theodosius won on the second.

events.title: Liu Yan proclaims himself emperor, founding the Southern Han
events.description: Liu Yan, military governor of Lingnan at Guangzhou in succession to his brother Liu Yin, proclaimed himself emperor of Great Yue, renaming the state Han the next year. Southern Han, one of the Ten Kingdoms, lived on the sea trade.

events.title: Swa Saw Ke becomes king of Ava in Upper Burma
events.description: Swa Saw Ke became king of Ava, the kingdom founded by Thado Minbya in 1365, and restored central authority in Upper Burma for the first time since the fall of Pagan. In 1385 he began the Forty Years' War against Hanthawaddy.

events.title: Peter the Great shaves his nobles' beards
events.description: Back from his Grand Embassy to western Europe, Peter I personally cut off the beards of leading boyars. A tax on beards followed, part of his drive to westernise Russia's elite.

events.title: The First Continental Congress meets in Philadelphia
events.description: Delegates from twelve colonies gathered at Carpenters' Hall to coordinate resistance to Britain's Intolerable Acts. They agreed a boycott of British goods and planned to meet again.

events.title: Crazy Horse is killed at Camp Robinson
events.description: The Oglala Lakota leader Crazy Horse, a victor at Little Bighorn, was bayoneted by a soldier while resisting arrest at Camp Robinson, Nebraska. He died that night.
events.html: The Oglala Lakota leader Crazy Horse, a victor at Little Bighorn, was bayoneted by a soldier while resisting arrest at Camp Robinson, Nebraska. He died that night.

events.title: Palestinian gunmen seize Israeli athletes at the Munich Olympics
events.description: Black September militants killed two members of the Israeli team and took nine hostage. All nine and a West German policeman died in a failed rescue at Fürstenfeldbruck airbase.

events.title: Lynette Fromme tries to shoot President Ford
events.description: Manson Family follower Lynette 'Squeaky' Fromme aimed a pistol at Gerald Ford in Sacramento, but no round was chambered. A second attempt on Ford came 17 days later.
